rationale: The AI/RAG domain appears in both splits, while test also covers cybersecurity. This is more coherent than placing cybersecurity alone in development and both AI slide decks in test.
duplicate_group_constraint: All documents in one duplicate_group must remain in one split.
near_duplicate_constraint: Human-confirmed near versions must remain in one split.
cross_document_query_constraint: All relevant documents for a query must belong to the query split.
limitations: Only three eligible real documents were available.
Cybersecurity is represented only in test.
The development document is much longer than either test document.
The split and every candidate query assignment still require human approval.
